result.brief: 提出 MotionCoach 多模态智能体，通过多轮工具与自验证生成 grounded prompt 和参考片段，为视频编辑模型注入专业运动知识，并构建 VPMEBench 评测基准。
result.reason: Multimodal agent constructs grounded prompts and reference clips to guide video editing models for fine-grained professional motion editing, directly serving controllable video editing.
